snippet.title: Moldwasher - Official Gameplay Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase September 2025
snippet.description: Clean moldy messes as a brave food hero! Equip your high-pressure spray, choose the right nozzle, and clear away sticky messes in this cozy, arcade-style fridge-cleaning adventure. Watch the Moldwasher trailer to see gameplay and more. Moldwasher will be available on PC.
